Its management strategy calls for expanding the transportation network by making use of the relay transportation (e-change) platform, expanding EC logistics, expanding the joint delivery network and evolving procurement logistics, and states that it will promote DX and invest in human capital. In its 5-year medium-term management plan starting in fiscal 2026, it has announced a plan to make business investment of ¥33 billion and to reach operating revenue of ¥61 billion in the fiscal year ending March 2031, the final year of the plan.
